decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known oas Strawberry House, Chiswick Mall.

Condition : 4 - Except at the permitted point of access, the existing acees to Netheravon Road shall be closed and reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access to the carriageway, in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, and completed before the development hereby approved is occupied. Reinstatement shall include reinstatement of the grass verge.

Condition : 5 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No.C218/P01A  shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Demolition of existing garages and orangery, erection of new garage, single storey garden store, and recreational / multi purpose garden building to existing dwellinghouse
